controlled_experiments.E1: Fix F1 MEDIUM and tariff; compare deterministic, S1 and frozen S2 policies
controlled_experiments.E2: Fix frozen S2 and MKT0; compare F1 LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH
controlled_experiments.E3: Fix forecast and F1 MEDIUM; compare MKT0/MKT1/MKT2/MKT3 assumptions
controlled_experiments.E4: Fix forecast, physical model and tariff; compare risk-neutral with predeclared CVaR grid
controlled_experiments.E5: Cross-site synthesis only where target and tariff semantics remain explicit
